description: A complete, opensource dashboard that shows consumption and usage of Open WebUI.

panels.description: Displays key usage statistics for Open WebUI, including model count, total prompt tokens, average tokens/s, and average processing time.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "openwebui_stats")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["model"] =~ /${model:regex}/)
  |> keep(columns: ["model"])
  |> distinct(column: "model")
  |> group()
  |> count()

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "openwebui_stats")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "promptTokens")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["model"] =~ /${model:regex}/)
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> sum()

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "openwebui_stats")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "responseTokensPerS")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["model"] =~ /${model:regex}/)
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> mean()

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "openwebui_stats")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "approximateTotalMS")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["model"] =~ /${model:regex}/)
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> mean()

panels.title: Open WebUI Usage Overview

panels.description: Displays token usage across models in a bar gauge format.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "openwebui_stats")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "totalTokens")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["model"] =~ /${model:regex}/)
  |> group(columns: ["model"])
  |> sum()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_value"] > 0)
  |> yield(name: "tokens_by_model")

panels.title: Token Usage by Model (Total Tokens)

panels.description: Tokens over time by model (total tokens).

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "openwebui_stats")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "totalTokens")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["model"] != "unknown")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["model"] =~ /${model:regex}/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "sum")
